summary: Tested the 4 new EBCS features end-to-end (MFA login challenge, password reset OTP flow, OCR pipeline, WebSocket live push) via 13 pytest cases against the live preview URL + Playwright UI flows on /login, /forgot-password, dashboard and /customers/3 KYC tab. 12/13 backend cases and all 4 frontend flows pass. One CRITICAL security bug found: the MFA challenge JWT (purpose=mfa-challenge) is accepted as a full access token on protected endpoints, completely bypassing MFA. Two minor deviations from spec also documented.

critical.issue: MFA bypass: JWT issued with claim purpose='mfa-challenge' (the challengeToken returned from /api/auth/login when MFA is enabled) is accepted as a valid access token on all protected endpoints. GET /api/customers with Authorization: Bearer <challengeToken> returns 200 instead of 401/403. Anyone with valid username/password can therefore skip the TOTP step entirely. The security filter/JwtAuthenticationFilter must reject tokens whose `purpose` claim is not 'access'.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 422 (Unprocessable Entity) for business validation errors ('Incorrect code. N attempt(s) remaining.', 'No active reset code', 'Reset session expired.'). Review request specifies HTTP 400. Behaviour/messages are otherwise correct. Either accept 422 in spec or change error handler to 400 for these three cases.

Uploading a NEW version of an existing (ownerType, ownerId, docType) document while the OCR feature flag is OFF does NOT reset the document's ocrText/ocrStatus fields; GET /api/documents/{id} still returns the stale COMPLETED status/text from the previous version. New file bytes are replaced but OCR metadata is not — expected behaviour would be to clear ocrText and set ocrStatus=NONE for the new version when flag is off (or re-OCR when on). Workaround in tests: use unique docType per upload.

ui_bugs.issue: After submitting an incorrect OTP the toast 'Incorrect code. N attempt(s) remaining.' appears (good), but the 6-digit input keeps the previously entered value (observed '000000' still in the field). Spec required OTP field to clear on error.

issues: Multiple recharts warnings in console: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Non-blocking but noisy; likely a container that renders before layout is measured (add ResizeObserver or minWidth/minHeight on chart wrapper).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix JwtAuthenticationFilter to reject JWTs whose 'purpose' claim is not 'access' (or is 'mfa-challenge'/'password-reset'). Add tests to ensure challenge tokens cannot access /api/**.
Decide on 400 vs 422 for password-reset validation errors; either align backend to 400 or update PRD.
Reset ocrText/ocrStatus when a new document version is uploaded (or re-run OCR based on the feature flag at upload time).
Clear the fp-step-otp input value after an incorrect code submission.
Suppress or fix recharts width/height warnings on Dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Missing purpose-claim enforcement in JWT filter is a P0 security bug — the whole MFA feature is bypassable.
Document versioning silently leaves stale OCR metadata; violates least-astonishment for consumers of GET /api/documents/{id}.
Backend uses 422 for domain validation errors while the frontend/spec expects 400 — inconsistency between REST error model and API contract.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI flows verified: MFA challenge, Forgot password 3-step, WS live badge + event banner, OCR badge + doc-ocr-text-*)

context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. It requires admin's MFA to be DISABLED at start; if a prior run left MFA enabled fetch the secret from `SELECT secret FROM user_mfa WHERE username='admin' AND enabled=true;` and complete login-verify+DELETE /api/security/mfa before rerunning. Rate limiter is 20/min on /api/auth/login; pytest sequential run is fine. Do NOT set `-n auto` — session-scope admin_token gets confused across MFA state. Only remaining failing test is TestMFA::test_full_mfa_challenge_flow because of the CRITICAL security bug above; once fixed, all 13 should pass.
rca of the issue: MFA bypass RCA — the login endpoint issues two JWT flavours signed with the SAME key: an access token (purpose=access, 24h) and an MFA challenge token (purpose=mfa-challenge, 5min). The Spring Security JWT filter only validates signature/expiration and populates the SecurityContext with the sub+roles. It never inspects the `purpose` claim, so ANY well-formed JWT with a valid signature (including challenge tokens and — likely — password-reset tokens) grants full access. Reproduction: (1) Enable MFA on admin. (2) POST /api/auth/login -> receive {challengeToken}. (3) GET /api/customers with Authorization: Bearer <challengeToken> -> 200. Fix: in JwtAuthenticationFilter (or JwtService.validate), reject tokens whose purpose claim is not exactly 'access'. Also verify password-reset purpose tokens are similarly not accepted.
